issue_context.title: [wasm] avoid eval, design better API for InvokeJS
issue_context.body:
After change https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/61212 Rollup started producing warning about eval.
```
(!) Use of eval is strongly discouraged
  https://rollupjs.org/guide/en/#avoiding-eval
  method-calls.ts
```

We could suppress it globally, but it's not ideal.
```
{
  onwarn(warning, warn) {
    if (warning.code === 'EVAL') return
    warn(warning)
  }
}
```

As @lewing  [suggested](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/61192), we should consider deprecating the method, since it's only internal API.
